tapeLine: US stocks rose Friday, with the S&P 500 up 0.6% to 7,811.54, just short of its record from three days earlier, the Nasdaq up 0.6% to 27,366.17 and the Dow up 0.8% to 51,654.95, per a La Nacion report of the closing numbers. A second summary (parameter.io) put the Dow at 51,829 and the 10-year yield close at 5.18% against 5.24% elsewhere, so the Dow level is from one source and no yield level is carried. No Monday-morning US futures were found.
matters:
US indexes recovered Friday, with the S&P 500 closing just short of its record, per La Nacion. A summary on parameter.io puts the weekly gains at S&P 500 +1.2% and Nasdaq +2%; that is a single source.

The 10-year Treasury yield was reported near its highest in nearly two decades, at 5.24% midday per AP and 5.18% at the close per parameter.io; sources disagree. The cash Treasury market is closed Monday for Columbus Day while equities stay open, per CMC Markets.

September CPI is due Wednesday and JPMorgan reports Tuesday, per CMC Markets and Investinglive previews. No consensus or prior figures were found, so the calendar is left empty. The next FOMC meeting is 27–28 October.

Invalidation: whether the S&P 500 takes out its record close, and whether yields keep rising into CPI.
alsoOnTape: Brent crude was reported near $104 amid uncertainty over the Iran war, per a single summary (parameter.io); no second source, so no level is carried. Gold is not carried.
overnight: US Friday close — S&P 500 +0.6% to 7,811.54, Nasdaq +0.6% to 27,366.17, Dow +0.8% to 51,654.95, per La Nacion; Dow level differs in another summary.
macro: Rates — 10-year near its highest in nearly two decades Friday; close reported as 5.18% or 5.24% depending on source.
Data — September CPI Wednesday; PPI, retail sales and jobless claims Thursday, per Investinglive.
Holiday — cash Treasury market closed Monday; equities open, per CMC Markets.
flow: Breadth, dealer gamma, put-call and skew are paid data and are not on this page.

regime.tag: Stocks bounced Friday to within reach of record highs while yields stayed near multi-year highs.
regime.sizing: Equities rebounded but rates remain elevated; CPI Wednesday is the next scheduled evidence.

secondOrder: The S&P 500 sits close to a record while the 10-year sits near a two-decade high. That is an observation, not a forecast.

scorecard.text: Friday's test was whether the 10-year holds near its multi-year high. Both Friday readings (5.18% and 5.24%) stayed near the high, per AP and parameter.io.
Friday's test of whether chip and AI stocks keep selling off cannot be graded: indexes rose Friday, but no sourced chip-sector move was found.
The 27-28 October FOMC has not occurred.
